correctness.rationale: The definition requires disjoint nonempty proper prefix/suffix for every ordered pair, including self pairs. Distinct selected words cannot occupy the same primitive length-n cyclic orbit. For n=5..12 Mobius inversion gives necklace limits (1,2,5,8,14,20,30,40). Independently rebuilt all fixed-weight-four words and cyclic orbits; checked actual complete certificate.json codebooks of sizes 1,2,5,8,14,20,30,39 are pairwise nonoverlapping and self-unbordered. At n=12, independently enumerated all 495 words, precisely 128 eligible ones, and validated the 39 disjoint cliques as covering the entire eligible set with pairwise conflicts. Thus an admissible code contains at most 39, and given 39-word code attains it. n=4 only word 1111 self-bordered. Finite enumeration is exhaustive in the asserted interval, not an infinite-length proof.
